Investors.ai_medical_personas_and_the_un.source: AI medical personas and the unified score act on the data in real time, and sharing closes the loop back to actual care.

Investors.alafia_is_a_6igma_health_platf.source: ALAFIA is a 6igma health platform. It unifies labs, medications, nutrition, fitness, mental health and clinical care into a single model of a person, and puts an intelligent agent on top of that model rather than beside it.
Investors.alafia_is_a_6igma_health_platf.translation: ALAFIA ni jukwaa la afya la 6igma. Inachanganya maabara, dawa, kula vizuri, fitness, afya ya akili na huduma ya kliniki katika mfano mmoja wa mtu, na inaweka wakala wa akili juu ya mfano huo badala ya kando yake.

Investors.an_intelligent_health_platform.source: An intelligent health platform built for the patients who cost the system the most.
Investors.an_intelligent_health_platform.translation: Jukwaa la akili linaloundwa kwa wagonjwa ambao gharama yao kwa mfumo ni kubwa zaidi.

Investors.data_sharing_plugs_into_clinic.source: Data sharing plugs into clinical workflows instead of living beside them. That is what turns a consumer app into something a health system or an insurer buys.
Investors.data_sharing_plugs_into_clinic.translation: Kushiriki data kuunganisha katika mtiririko wa kazi wa kliniki badala ya kuishi kando yake. Ndilo linalobadilisha programu ya watumiaji kuwa kitu ambacho mfumo wa afya au mtumaji wa bima anunua.

Investors.global_spanning_wellness_healt.source: Global, spanning wellness, health, fitness, nutrition and public health.
Investors.global_spanning_wellness_healt.translation: Ulimwengu, inayokamatia afya, fitness, kula vizuri na afya ya umma.

Investors.most_platforms_aggregate_metri.source: Most platforms aggregate metrics. ALAFIA models wellness as a mathematical system with a stable manifold and a distance function.
Investors.most_platforms_aggregate_metri.translation: Jukwaa nyingi zinakusanya vipimo. ALAFIA inatengeneza afya kama mfumo wa hisabati na manifold thabiti na kazi ya umbali.

Investors.nutrients_medications_labs_fit.source: Nutrients, medications, labs, fitness, environment and mental health feed one view of a person — a 360° picture with no gap.
Investors.nutrients_medications_labs_fit.translation: Virutubishi, dawa, maabara, fitness, mazingira na afya ya akili huingia katika mtazamo mmoja wa mtu — picha ya 360° bila pengo.

Investors.physician_sharing_is_the_wedge.translation: Kushiriki kwa daktari ndio kile kilicho na kingo

Investors.the_entry_point_is_chronic_dis.source: The entry point is chronic disease — ESRD and dialysis, diabetes, and anyone whose condition has to be managed daily rather than occasionally. That cohort needs the “distance from a stable operating manifold” framing every day, is the most expensive population in the system, and is where the return is clearest to patients, clinicians, administrators and insurers alike.
Investors.the_entry_point_is_chronic_dis.translation: Njia ya kuingia ni ugonjwa wa muda mrefu — ESRD na dialysis, sukari, na kila mtu ambaye hali yake lazima idhibitwe kila siku badala ya mara kwa mara. Kundi hilo linahitaji framing ya "umbali kutoka kwa manifold thabiti ya uendeshaji" kila siku, ni idadi ghali zaidi katika mfumo, na ndipo kurudi kwa wagonjwa, wataalamu wa kliniki, wasimamizi na watumiaji wa bima kuwa wazi zaidi.

Investors.we_share_the_deck_the_technica.source: We share the deck, the technical detail behind the wellness model, and current status on request. There is no public offering here — this page is an overview, not a solicitation, and nothing on it is a projection or a promise of returns.
Investors.we_share_the_deck_the_technica.translation: Tunashiriki deck, maelezo ya kiteknolojia nyuma ya mfano wa afya, na hali ya sasa kwa ombi. Hakuna pendekezo la umma hapa — ukurasa huu ni muhtasari, si ombi, na hakuna kitu juu yake ni makadirio au ahadi ya kurudi.

Landing.alafia_is_an_intelligent_health_.source: ALAFIA is an Intelligent health platform that unifies your entire health universe — labs, medications, fitness, nutrition, mental wellness, and clinical care — into one intelligent, wholesome experience.

Landing.connect_with_physicians_coordina.source: Connect with physicians, coordinate your care team, and manage appointments from one hub.

Landing.our_agentic_ai_doesn_t_just_stor.source: Our agentic AI doesn't just store data. It understands you, learns from you, and works alongside you to chart a course toward optimal health — mind, body, and spirit.

Landing.we_believe_every_person_deserves.source: We believe every person deserves a guardian angel for their health — an intelligent, compassionate companion that never sleeps, never forgets, and always advocates for your total wellbeing.
